wiki:
Skill proficiency is gained when sailing for long distances.

Additional notes:

1. Currently equipped ship MUST have at least 1 skill added to it; any skill will work, even if you cannot yet use the skill(s), more skills (max 6)= more Navigation proficiency
2. The greater the distance, the better the skill proficiency gained, sailing days do not matter, only distance
3. It is possible to gain skill proficiency if you are being towed in a fleet
4. Unlike Arms, the total ship level does not matter
